desc: It takes one look at the Flatbed to know that it means business. A tactical folder, this assisted knife has everything Kershaw fans want in a reliable knife. Its tanto blade is great for piecing cuts, and the BlackWash blade finish hides use scratches. A BlackWash steel inlay adds a stealthy layer to the G10-textured handle. The overall profile is designed to be big without becoming overbearing, and the deep-carry pocket clip makes it easy to carry. Like a reliable pickup truck, this Starter Series tactical knife works hard and gets the job done.
